findings: On 7a18de77 each unique frozen manifest requires one DATASET_MANIFEST binding. A blank or unequal fingerprint is MANIFEST_MISMATCH before the value loader. The recipe-only helper that omits both data_bindings and availability_cutoff still skips the check.

The published corpus stays COMPLETE and the passport carries the manifest id and fingerprint that were used. Commissioning substitution, a missing binding, an undeclared manifest, a duplicate, a wrong fingerprint, and a null fingerprint stop before the value loader without COMPLETE.
FAST_LANE_READY does not grant frozen-manifest identity. FAILED_INFRA remains a technical stop with scientific_terminal INVALID. None==None is not a fingerprint match.
A binding failure is FAILED_INFRA or a classifier deny with an explicit reason code. It is not a COMPLETE scientific result. No new owner command was added.
